{% comment %}
  An index for language models and agents (llmstxt.org): what Wicket is, which release to use,
  and where the complete documentation is. Everything comes from _data/releases.yml, the
  release line pages and _data/guide.yml.
{% endcomment %}{% assign root = site.url | append: site.baseurl %}{% include reference-lines.html %}{% assign next = site.data.releases.lines | where: "status", "boarding" | first %}# Apache Wicket

> Apache Wicket is an open source, component-oriented Java web framework of the Apache Software Foundation. Every component keeps its behaviour and state in Java and its markup in plain HTML; there is no JavaScript build chain. Maven coordinates: groupId `org.apache.wicket`, artifactId `wicket-core`.

Release lines in service:
{% for line in site.data.releases.lines %}{% if line.page %}{% unless line.status == 'eol' %}{% assign hub = site.pages | where: "url", line.page | first %}
- Wicket {{ line.series }}{% if line.status == 'lts' %} (LTS){% endif %}: latest {{ site.wicket[line.config] }}, Java {{ hub.java }}+, {{ hub.servlet | replace: ' or newer', '+' }}. {% include line-status.html status=line.status %}, {{ line.support | replace: 'Until', 'supported until' }}.{% endunless %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if next %}
- Wicket {{ next.series }}: announced for {{ next.when }}, not yet released.{% endif %}

Wicket 10 and later use the `jakarta.*` namespace; Wicket 9 and earlier use `javax.*`.

## Reference guide

The complete user guide of each release line in one document.
{% for n in ref_lines %}
- [Wicket {{ n }}.x Reference Guide](https://nightlies.apache.org/wicket/guide/{{ n }}.x/single.html): one HTML page{% endfor %}{% if next %}
- [Wicket {{ next.series }}.x Reference Guide](https://nightlies.apache.org/wicket/guide/{{ next.series }}.x/single.html): one HTML page, for the upcoming release{% endif %}
